review_method: Deterministic set review over six accepted_locked, exact-Git-read-back, saved-Git-reviewed production PNGs.

set_review.basis: Six distinct sealed subjects/mechanisms and production paths; every saved Git asset independently passed structural/editorial/text/factual/no-people gates and now has story-specific alt text.

images.subject: Reusable Android CLI agent skills and device streaming
images.mechanism: A layered mobile-automation workshop: a reusable skill capsule library feeds a single CLI command rail, which orchestrates a device-state cutaway, a live screen stream, bounded test actions, and signed result evidence returning to the skill library.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Reusable Android CLI agent skills and device streaming: A layered mobile-automation workshop: a reusable skill capsule library feeds a single CLI command rail, which orchestrates a device-state cutaway, a live screen stream, bounded test actions, and signed result evidence returning to the skill library.

images.subject: Backend-state verification for agents
images.mechanism: A forensic split-plane architecture contrasts an upper claim channel with a lower durable-state channel; database records, side-effect receipts, and repeated-run samples converge through a verification tribunal into an immutable evidence ledger.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Backend-state verification for agents: A forensic split-plane architecture contrasts an upper claim channel with a lower durable-state channel; database records, side-effect receipts, and repeated-run samples converge through a verification tribunal into an immutable evidence ledger.

images.subject: Prompt-driven synchronized knowledge work across images, canvases, and applications
images.mechanism: A shared-source data spine feeds three visually distinct workbenches—object-level image editing, a prompt-built spreadsheet canvas, and cross-application execution—while provenance and synchronization rails reconcile changes into a review surface.

images.subject: Citation-grounded scientific report generation
images.mechanism: A research question enters a retrieval observatory; source fragments pass through relevance and support filters into a citation lattice, then a report composer emits claim blocks whose trace lines terminate at the exact supporting fragments and an independent verification panel.

images.subject: Bounded desktop computer use through an observe-plan-act loop
images.mechanism: A user-intent capsule enters a command console; an observe-plan-act control loop traverses multiple abstract desktop applications, pauses at confirmation gates for consequential actions, and writes each step into an audit trail.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Bounded desktop computer use through an observe-plan-act loop: A user-intent capsule enters a command console; an observe-plan-act control loop traverses multiple abstract desktop applications, pauses at confirmation gates for consequential actions, and writes each step into an audit trail.

images.subject: Event-driven ambient agents with human approval and resumable state
images.mechanism: An event bus opens an isolated session containing a durable job-state core; policy and confidence gates route steps either to bounded tool execution or an approval interrupt, after which the exact state resumes and closes with a complete audit trail.
